aaa_enabled.summary: Configure remote AAA administrative authentication (TACACS+ or RADIUS) on Ruckus FastIron.
cli: aaa authentication login default tacacs+ local
aaa_enabled.notes: Define TACACS+ or RADIUS server IPs and keys before assigning to the default login authentication order.

secure_vty_transport.summary: Disable insecure Telnet console access and enforce SSH management.
secure_vty_transport.notes: FastIron has Telnet server active by default. Explicitly disable it and enable the SSH daemon.

vty_idle_timeout.notes: Set console/VTY session idle-timeout in minutes (e.g. 10 minutes).

enable_secret_encrypted.summary: Configure an encrypted privilege super-user password.
enable_secret_encrypted.notes: Configures privilege level credentials. Passwords configured are automatically encrypted in the configuration file.

no_default_snmp_community.notes: Remove the default communities to restrict unauthorized MIB access.

http_server_disabled.summary: Disable insecure HTTP web management server.
http_server_disabled.notes: Ensure that unencrypted HTTP access is disabled.

ssh_version_2.notes: Ruckus FastIron OS enforces SSHv2 by default when SSH is enabled.

logging_enabled.notes: Add your central remote syslog server IP destination.

management_acl.summary: Apply client-acl to restrict management access.
management_acl.notes: Apply ACLs restricting access to authorized management subnet IP address ranges.

login_banner.notes: Configure a pre-login warning banner using a chosen delimiter character.

password_min_length.notes: Strict password enforcement sets password minimum length to 8 characters and requires characters combination complexity.

ntp_configured.notes: Specify upstream time servers to synchronize device event logging clocks.

no_write_snmp_community.summary: Restrict SNMP communities to read-only access.
no_write_snmp_community.notes: Ensure communities are mapped using 'ro' for read-only access.
